content: Researchers in Helsinki developed hybrid solar panels using perovskite and silicon that boost efficiency by around 30%, making solar power cheaper and more accessible.
title: Hybrid Solar Panels Boost Efficiency in Helsinki

content: A Finnish startup built an AI tool that spots early signs of Alzheimer's from MRI scans years before symptoms, potentially improving early diagnosis and treatment.
title: Finnish Startup Develops AI to Detect Early Alzheimer's Signs

content:
• Hornsea Three, North Sea's largest offshore wind farm, begins operations.
• 231 turbines can power over 2 million homes.
• Expected to reduce carbon emissions by 5 million tons annually.
• Provides green energy and creates local jobs.
title: Hornsea Three Offshore Wind Farm Now Operational
